import paramiko
import time
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")
# First check if docker-compose is there
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("ls -la /opt/areloria/docker-compose.yml 2>&1")
print("File:", stdout.read().decode())
# Start docker-compose in background
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria && nohup docker-compose up --build > /tmp/docker-build.log 2>&1 & echo started")
time.sleep(3)
print("Build started")
client.close()
EOF
